source.title: Call for Applicants - WCAT Members (February 2023)
source.content:
The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) is seeking new passionate and trustworthy members! The application is open to everyone. However, you must meet certain criteria to be considered for the position.

What does the WCAT do?

The daily tasks of a WCAT member include:

* Review and announce competitions around the world on a daily basis with accuracy and correctness.
* Handle change requests to competitions.
* Engage in frequent discussions through voting within the Team.
* The official rights and duties of the WCAT are documented in WCA Motion [10.2021.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf).

Applicants are expected to possess the following qualities:

* Proactive personality, detail-oriented, and solution-oriented mindset.
* Fluency in English.
* Ability to check internal messages and announce competitions multiple times a day.
* Good familiarity with the [WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf).
* Ability to devote at least 1 hour per day.
* Sufficient familiarity with the WCA Regulations and WCA Policies.

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* A brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* A concrete overview on how expected qualities are to be fulfilled.
* (Optional) Qualities and qualifications you find relevant that are not listed above.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until March 22nd, 2023 23:59 UTC to Wilson Alvis (walvis@worldcubeassociation.org).

translation.title: WCA 比赛公告团队招募成员（2023 年 2 月）
translation.content:
WCA 比赛公告团队（WCAT）正在招募热心、可靠的新成员！所有人都可以申请，但须符合以下条件才会进入选拔。

### WCAT 负责什么？

WCAT 成员的日常工作包括：

* 每天准确审核和公布世界各地的比赛。
* 处理比赛信息变更申请。
* 经常参与团队讨论和投票。
* WCAT 的正式权利与职责见 WCA 动议 [10.2021.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf)。

我们希望申请者具备：

* 主动、细心，并能着眼于解决问题。
* 英语流利。
* 每天能够多次查看内部消息、公布比赛。
* 熟悉[《WCA 比赛要求政策》（WCRP）](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf)。
* 每天能投入至少 1 小时。
* 对 WCA 规则和政策有足够了解。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

* 简短的自我介绍。
* 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
* 具体说明自己如何符合上述要求。
* 【可选】你认为与该岗位相关、但未在上面列出的能力和资历。

即日起至 2023 年 3 月 22 日 23:59 UTC，申请者可将材料发送给 Wilson Alvis（walvis@worldcubeassociation.org）。
